assertion.text: An exhaustive bounded search of the 13 primes in the inclusive range 10430401..10430600 found no k=15 witness; the maximum multiplicity observed was 11 at p=10430491, residue 4382886.

conditions: The retained producer enumerates every prime in 10430401..10430600, counts factorial residues modulo each prime, selects the smallest residue on a per-prime tie, and selects the earliest prime on a cross-prime tie.

Caveat: This is a bounded negative result for the exact retained range, algorithm, artifact, and verifier capsule. It does not establish universal nonexistence, resolve Erdős problem 1056, or change scientific Standing without an authorized human Decision.
